Historical Case Study · Q4 2023 → Year-End 2024

NVDA vs INTC
What the Indicators Showed.

Same sector. Same moment. Same market. Completely different signals. Completely different outcomes.

In Q4 2023, NVIDIA and Intel were both semiconductor companies trading in the same market environment. Both were widely covered. Both had narratives. To a casual observer, both looked like potential opportunities in the chip sector.

The technical indicators told a completely different story. These are the actual TradingView charts — pulled on the CCnati layout — showing exactly what the evidence looked like at the end of Q4 2023. Then the 2024 outcome charts show what happened after.

This is not hindsight analysis. Every signal shown here was visible in real time. The framework counted the evidence. The market confirmed it.

Layer 1 — Weekly Ichimoku · The Macro Regime

INTC · Weekly · Jan 2022 – Dec 2023 Replay frozen at Q4 2023
NVDA — Weekly Ichimoku
Cloud Configuration
ALIGNED

The weekly cloud converted from red to green in mid-2023 — visible in the chart. Price is trading above a green expanding cloud. Tenkan-Sen above Kijun-Sen. All four Ichimoku components aligned bullishly. This is the most favorable weekly configuration possible. A full bull regime change — confirmed and holding into Q4 2023.

OBV (Black Line)
ALIGNED

The black OBV line surged aggressively through 2023 and continued rising into Q4. OBV making new highs alongside price — institutional accumulation confirmed. The volume behind this move is real and sustained.

RSI 14 (Yellow Line)
ALIGNED

Weekly RSI recovered from deeply oversold in 2022 and is now in the trending range — 50–80 zone. Not overbought. Trending. This is healthy momentum in an established uptrend, with room to continue higher.

INTC — Weekly Ichimoku
Cloud Configuration
AGAINST

The weekly cloud is thick, red, and bearish — visible across the entire chart. Despite a price recovery in 2023, price spent the year inside or fighting the bottom of a descending bearish cloud. The cloud overhead is massive. Price approaching the underside of a thick red cloud is not a breakout — it is approaching a ceiling.

OBV (Black Line)
AGAINST

The black OBV line tells the honest story. While price recovered through 2023, OBV declined. Price up, OBV down — the textbook distribution signal. Larger players were selling into the retail recovery. This divergence is the single most important data point on the INTC chart.

RSI 14 (Yellow Line)
NEUTRAL

Weekly RSI recovered from extreme lows but remained subdued — bouncing from 20 toward 40–50. A recovery from oversold inside a bearish cloud structure is relief, not renewal. The context changes what the number means.

NVDA — Daily Structure
Setup Quality
ALIGNED

The daily shows a clear Q3 pullback into support — price retraced, held structure, and resumed the uptrend into year-end. The rising blue trendline confirms the series of higher lows. Stoch RSI (blue/orange lines) cycled from overbought, reset, and crossed back up — the timing confirmation a clean entry needs. Price closed 2023 at $49.52 with momentum intact.

Risk Architecture
ALIGNED

The Q3 pullback low provided a clear structural stop reference. R:R from a Q4 entry targeting the prior ATH zone cleared 3:1 comfortably. The setup had a defined invalidation level, a logical stop, and room to run. All three elements of Layer 4 confirmed.

INTC — Daily Structure
Setup Quality
AGAINST

The daily shows a recovery through H2 2023 — price moved from ~$30 to ~$50. But Stoch RSI pushed toward overbought territory at year-end while price approached the weekly cloud ceiling. A stock approaching overbought momentum readings at a structural ceiling is the entry timing the framework avoids. No clean entry structure visible.

Risk Architecture
AGAINST

The weekly cloud sat directly overhead capping the upside. With limited room to the ceiling and no clean structural stop that delivered 3:1 R:R, the risk architecture failed. When upside is capped and the stop is wide, the math doesn't work. No valid R:R = no GO.

What This Case Demonstrates

Two chip stocks. Same sector. Same market environment. Same quarter. The narratives on both were loud — NVIDIA was the AI infrastructure play, Intel was the great American comeback story. Both had reasons to own them if you were searching for reasons.

The framework does not search for reasons. It counts evidence.

NVDA had five layers aligned. INTC had zero. Not one layer working in the direction of a long trade. The OBV divergence on INTC was visible in Q4 2023. The bearish weekly cloud was visible. The failed risk architecture was visible. A trader who counted confluence rather than narratives had everything they needed — before the 2024 price action confirmed it.

PASS is not a failure. PASS is the framework working. The capital that didn't go into INTC at $50 was available for NVDA at $49.
